items.exampleEn: Our school choir excelled in the national singing contest this year.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校的合唱團今年在全國歌唱比賽中表現出色。

items.exampleEn: Waiting in line for six hours for concert tickets takes real endurance.
items.exampleZh: 為了演唱會門票排六小時的隊，真的需要耐力。

items.exampleEn: The boxer bowed to the crowd before the match began.
items.exampleZh: 拳擊手在比賽開始前向觀眾鞠躬。

items.exampleEn: The city built a new athletics track next to the river.
items.exampleZh: 市政府在河邊蓋了一座新的田徑跑道。

items.exampleEn: Try to sprint for twenty seconds, then walk slowly for one minute.
items.exampleZh: 試著衝刺二十秒，然後慢走一分鐘。

items.exampleEn: The judges disqualified the cake because it was made with a shop-bought base.
items.exampleZh: 評審取消了那個蛋糕的資格，因為它用的是買來的蛋糕底。

items.exampleEn: Polo is a team sport in which players ride horses.
items.exampleZh: 馬球是一種騎在馬背上進行的團隊運動。

items.exampleEn: In the old western film, the hero refuses to fight a duel.
items.exampleZh: 在那部老西部片裡，主角拒絕決鬥。

items.exampleEn: We took a scuba course before our trip to the island.
items.exampleZh: 去那座島旅行前，我們上了水肺潛水課。

items.sentenceEn: Marathon runners need great endurance to keep going for hours.
items.sentenceZh: 馬拉松跑者需要很強的耐力才能持續跑好幾個小時。

items.audioEn: The scuba trip leaves at nine, and all the equipment is included in the price.
items.audioZh: 水肺潛水行程九點出發，價格包含所有裝備。

items.sentenceEn: The two chess champions met for a final duel in front of a large crowd.
items.sentenceZh: 兩位西洋棋冠軍在眾多觀眾面前進行最後對決。

items.sentenceEn: My sister does athletics after school: running, jumping and throwing.
items.sentenceZh: 我妹妹放學後練田徑：跑步、跳遠和投擲。

items.stemEn: A runner who starts before the gun is fired can be ____.
items.stemZh: 槍聲響起前就起跑的選手，可能會被取消資格。

items.stemEn: The ____ trained hard and won the match in the third round.
items.stemZh: 那位拳擊手努力訓練，在第三回合贏得比賽。

items.passageEn: Our school's sports day offered something for everyone. In athletics, the fastest students raced in the 100-meter sprint, while others tested their endurance in a long run around the park. A former boxer and local legend, who now works as a trainer, taught a short class on how to move your feet. In the pool, students played water polo, and a diving club showed how scuba equipment works. The most exciting moment was a final duel between two runners. One was disqualified for stepping out of his lane, but he shook hands with the winner. Our teacher said that every student can excel at something.
items.passageZh: 我們學校的運動會，每個人都能找到適合的項目。田徑方面，跑最快的同學參加百米短跑，其他人則在公園繞長跑，考驗耐力。一位現在當教練、也是在地傳奇人物的前拳擊手，教了一堂如何移動腳步的小課。泳池裡，同學們打水球，潛水社則示範水肺潛水裝備怎麼用。最刺激的一刻是兩位跑者的最後對決。其中一人因為踩出跑道被取消資格，但他還是和勝利者握了手。老師說，每個學生都能在某件事上表現出色。

questions.questionZh: 前拳擊手在運動會上做了什麼？
options: 教了一堂移動腳步的課
當了田徑比賽的計時裁判

questions.questionZh: 那位跑者為什麼被取消資格？

items.promptZh: 他在數學和科學方面表現優異。
referenceEn: He excels in math and science.
He excels at both math and science.
rubricZh: excel 後面接領域，例如 excel in…、excel at… 等
時態合理即可（例如 excels、excelled）

items.promptZh: 最後一百公尺，她開始全力衝刺。
referenceEn: In the last hundred meters, she began to sprint as fast as she could.
She sprinted at full speed for the last hundred meters.
rubricZh: sprint 當動詞，表示「衝刺」（例如 began to sprint、sprinted 等）
「全力」可寫，例如 as fast as she could、at full speed 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 began、begins 等）
